findings.title: Pays 11.5M MNDE to a previous payee
findings.explanation: Sends 11,549,999 MNDE (~11.5M) from DAO MNDE account H988…Mo6u — that is 9.0% of that treasury account and 3.6% of all MNDE held by this DAO — to 4Dh5…Mu7a (a MNDE account owned by 9JAj…gc6f). This DAO has paid this address before.

findings.title: No hold-up time
findings.explanation: Instruction #1 can be executed the moment voting ends — hold-up time is 0, so nobody has time to react (withdraw funds, alert the council) if the vote is won by an attacker. This governance's minimum hold-up time is 0 (executes immediately).
